description: Search noon.com in seven GCC storefronts, browse categories, look up products by SKU or URL, and filter by price, rating, discount, brand, seller, or deal tag.

brand.description: Optional brand name or brand code, e.g. `HP` or `hp`. Matched against noon's brand filter.
brand.title: Brand

categoryPaths.description: noon category paths or URLs (mode=byCategory), e.g. `electronics-and-mobiles/computers-and-accessories/computers-new/laptops`.
categoryPaths.title: Category paths or URLs

dealOnly.description: Only emit products carrying a noon deal tag.
dealOnly.title: Deals only

includeDetails.description: Add description, specifications, stock, warranty, delivery, and all seller offers. Adds one request per product.
includeDetails.title: Fetch product details

includeReviews.description: Add up to five latest review snippets per product. Adds one request per product.
includeReviews.title: Fetch recent reviews

language.description: Product titles and descriptions language used by the storefront.
language.title: Language

market.description: noon storefront and currency. Product and URL inputs can override it from the URL.
market.title: Market

maxDiscountPercent.description: Only emit products discounted by at most this percentage. Set 0 to require no discount.
maxDiscountPercent.title: Maximum discount (%)

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted products across the whole run.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxPrice.description: Only emit products at or below this price, in the selected market's currency.
maxPrice.title: Maximum price

minDiscountPercent.description: Only emit products discounted by at least this percentage. Products without a list price have no discount and are excluded.
minDiscountPercent.title: Minimum discount (%)

minPrice.description: Only emit products at or above this price, in the selected market's currency.
minPrice.title: Minimum price

minRating.description: Only emit rated products at or above this star rating (0-5). Unrated products are excluded when this is set.
minRating.title: Minimum rating

mode.description: Choose what to fetch. Search needs `searchQueries`; category needs `categoryPaths`; product needs `productInputs`; URL needs `startUrls`.
enumTitles: Look up products by SKU or product URL
Fetch from noon search, category, or product URLs
mode.title: Mode

productInputs.description: noon SKUs or product URLs (mode=byProduct), e.g. `N70367827V`.
productInputs.title: Product SKUs or URLs

searchQueries.description: Keywords to search for (mode=search). One query per line, e.g. `laptop`.
searchQueries.title: Search queries

seller.description: Optional seller name or seller code, e.g. `noon` or `p_9404`.
seller.title: Seller

sortBy.description: Ordering for search and category results.
sortBy.title: Sort results by

startUrls.description: noon search, category, or product URLs (mode=byUrl). The market in each URL overrides the Market field.
startUrls.title: Start URLs

title: Noon.com Multi-Market Product Search Input
